mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id userId, c.file_md5 fileMd5, c.file_name fileName, c.file_url fileUrl, c.is_dir isDir, c.is_valid isValid, c.file_size fileSize, c.file_path filePath, c.create_time uploadTime, u.actual_name userName, c.storage_type storageType, c.extend_name extendName FROM t_wp_user_file c LEFT JOIN t_base_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.is_valid =1 and u.is_valid =1 and c.id = #{id} order BY c.create_time desc
SELECT SUM(a.file_size) FROM t_wp_user_file a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} and a.is_valid =1
